name: Super Minds 6 — 2nd Edition
source: Teacher's Book (620K chars) + Student's Book (172K chars)

units.title: Back to school
units.topic: Ôn tập: đồ vật ở trường, thì hiện tại hoàn thành với already/yet, mệnh đề quan hệ
units.grammar: Present perfect với already/yet (ôn). Mệnh đề quan hệ who/which/where. / Have you had some food yet? We have already met. / I'm the leopard who likes to rap.
key_phrases: Have you had some food yet?
We have already met.
This is the jungle where I rule.

units.title: The treasure
units.topic: Cướp biển, hiện tại hoàn thành với for/since
units.grammar: Present perfect với for và since; How long have you …? / I've had these lovely spots since I was a cub. / How long have you had them? — Since I was thirteen. For eleven weeks.
key_phrases: I've had my big, long tail for eleven years.
How long have you had them?

units.title: Future transport
units.topic: Phương tiện tương lai, need to, will/won't
units.grammar: need to; will/won't. / You don't need to drive a car. / All you need to do is climb to get from here to there. / There won't be any trees left.
key_phrases: You don't need to drive a car.
There will be a lot of noise.
They'll have to run away.

units.title: Ancient Egypt
units.topic: Ai Cập cổ đại, bị động quá khứ, lượng từ
units.grammar: Past passive; a lot of / lots of / a few / a little. / Who was this den built by? / The walls weren't built so well. / There were lots of trees in this jungle a few years ago.
key_phrases: Who was this den built by?
The door was put in upside down.

units.title: Olympic sports
units.topic: Thể thao Olympic, could (khả năng), hiện tại tiếp diễn cho tương lai
units.grammar: could (khả năng); present continuous cho kế hoạch tương lai. / We could play some volleyball. / You could try to teach me. / I'm running in the morning.
key_phrases: We could play some volleyball.
I'm cycling on my bike.

units.title: In London
units.topic: London, cửa hàng, hiện tại hoàn thành với ever/never
units.grammar: Present perfect với ever/never; present perfect và past simple. / Have you ever been to London? — Yes, I have. / She's never been. / I had a swim. I went home.
key_phrases: Have you ever been to London?
She's never been.

units.title: Crazy inventions
units.topic: Phát minh, too many / not enough, câu hỏi gián tiếp
units.grammar: too many / not enough; Can you tell me what … is/does? / I've got too many jobs to do. / I haven't got enough time. / Can you tell me what this button does?
key_phrases: I've got too many jobs to do.
Can you tell me what the machine is for?

units.title: This is Houston
units.topic: Chinh phục Mặt Trăng, danh động từ, câu tường thuật
units.grammar: Gerunds; reported speech. / Going on a space trip is exciting! / He said that he was back from the stars. / He said that he didn't know the way.
key_phrases: Going on a space trip is exciting!
He said that he was back from the stars.

units.title: A cold place
units.topic: Bắc Cực, câu hỏi đuôi, may/might
units.grammar: Question tags với be; may/might. / It's cold at the poles, isn't it? / The jungle may be in danger. / They might take our home away.
key_phrases: It's cold at the poles, isn't it?
They might take our home away.

units.title: The Jurassic Age
units.topic: Thời tiền sử, câu điều kiện loại 2
units.grammar: Second conditional; second conditional questions. / If I had a time machine, I'd go back to the past. / What would you do if you saw a dinosaur? / If I met a dinosaur, I wouldn't stop to say hello.
key_phrases: If I had a time machine, I'd go back to the past.
What would you do if you saw a dinosaur?
units.phonics: Âm /ə/ và ngữ điệu câu hỏi

nguon: Super Minds 6 (2nd ed.) — Map of the course, TB Ucalearn
